prompt: This flat vector illustration depicts a bustling farm scene during harvest. In the center stands a tall wooden barn with weathered gray planks. To the left of the barn, a woman in a yellow sunhat holds a woven basket filled with golden wheat. Next to her, a brown dog sits patiently on the dry earth, looking up at her hand. A man in blue overalls stands beside the dog, pointing toward the field where a red tractor is parked. The tractor has large black tires and an empty trailer attached. On the right side of the image, a boy in a striped shirt runs toward a pile of pumpkins. He reaches out to grab a large orange pumpkin from the stack. Beside the pumpkin pile, a girl in a pink dress watches him with a smile. Behind them, an old farmer in a green vest leans against a wooden fence post. A white goat stands next to the farmer, chewing on a piece of hay. Above the fence, a black crow perches on the top rail, observing the scene. In the foreground, a silver watering can lies tipped over near a patch of corn stalks. A small child in a denim jacket crouches near the corn, examining a leaf. A tabby cat sleeps on top of a hay bale located between the barn and the tractor. A rooster with bright red comb struts near the sleeping cat. A windmill stands in the distant background on the far left, its blades still. A scarecrow wearing a tattered hat stands in the field on the far right. There is no sky gradient, only a solid light blue background. There is no shadow detail under the objects. There is no text or signage anywhere in the image.
